definitions.explanation: Physical strength or power. Also used for ability, capability, or influence.

examples.japanese: {力|ちから}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くします→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: I will do my best. (lit. exhaust all my power)

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力|ちから}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばしたい→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my Japanese ability.

notes:
{力|ちから} has many uses from physical strength to abstract power or ability.
